label: rem:golden-ratio-degeneration-brings
title: Golden-ratio cusp and the sub-classical regime $q<1$
html:
Remark. Golden-ratio cusp and the sub-classical regime q<1

Golden ratio degeneration. The second Weierstrass coefficient r(q) contains the factor (s^2 + s - 1) in its numerator. This vanishes at s = (\sqrt{5} - 1)/2 = 1/\varphi, the reciprocal of the golden ratio \varphi = (1 + \sqrt{5})/2. At this value q = 1/\varphi^2 = (3 - \sqrt{5})/2 \approx 0.382, the curve \mathcal{E}_q acquires a cusp. The elliptic fiber degenerates and the color fibration becomes singular.
